caption: A car approaches from behind, and its image grows larger in the rear-view mirror of the car ahead.

sa.check: A car approaches from behind another car.
Its image grows larger in the rear-view mirror of the car ahead.
The image is seen behind, not ahead.
The image grows as the car closes in.

pc.expect: The reflected car grows as the real one closes in and would shrink if it fell back.
pc.fail: The image stays one size as the car closes; or it shrinks as the car nears; or it grows with the gap unchanged.

pc.expect: The image is a mirror image of the following car, seen behind, with any lettering reversed.
pc.fail: It is a different car; or it shows the road ahead; or its lettering reads the right way round.

pc.expect: The image moves only as the cars move.
pc.fail: It jumps; or moves while both cars are stopped; or drifts across the mirror.

pc.expect: The mirror is flat and rigid: the image is undistorted.
pc.fail: The mirror ripples; or the image warps; or the mirror bends.

pc.expect: Two cars and one mirror image of the following one.
pc.fail: A third car appears; or the image leaves the mirror; or a car vanishes; or the image becomes solid.

pc.expect: The cars' colours and the road stay the same.
pc.fail: A car changes colour; or the mirror changes; or the road rearranges.
